You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Marcus Reddy. Dentist. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Reading Glasses, Trail compass, Field suture kit, Boot stone, Search locket. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit.
